description:
Fetch a group: its name, description, picture and settings.

Returns how many participants it has, not who they are. Membership is
deliberately not readable: it arrives as it changes, on the
`group.participants_added` / `_removed` / `_promoted` / `_demoted`
events, which `list_events` can read.

group_id.description: Group id (`grp_…`), from `list_groups`. It belongs to the number you listed it under: passing it under a different number answers not found, which means wrong inbox rather than deleted.
group_id.title: Group Id

number_alias.description: Which of the organization's WhatsApp numbers this acts on: `main`, the alias of an extra number, or the number's `id` (`num_…`), which stays the same when the alias is renamed. Call `list_numbers` to see them. Defaults to the main number.
number_alias.title: Number Alias

name: get_group
title: Get one group
